- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided details about The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met):
  - One of the world's largest and most famous museums with over 2 million works of art.
  - Collections include European paintings, ancient art, and Asian art.
  - Iconic works include Van Gogh's "Wheat Field with Cypresses" and Monet's "Impression, Sunrise."
  - Open 7 days a week with suggested admission being pay-what-you-wish.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided details about MoMA (Museum of Modern Art):
  - Influential modern art museum with over 200,000 works.
  - Iconic works include Van Gogh's "Starry Night" and Warhol's "Campbell's Soup Cans."
  - Open 7 days a week with admission around $25 for adults.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended visiting The Met first for its diverse collection.
